about: Count gate (PLAN-4.5 §3), checked by scripts/perf-gate.mjs in `npm test`. A metric fails when its value is above its limit. Limits may only go down: each PLAN-4.5 workstream lowers the ones it improves when it lands. `baseline` is the value measured when the limit was last set (`tolerance`: how far below it counts as an improvement). Exact limits for the counts, which repeat exactly (the select-row patch count can drop to 1,000 under CPU load, when two 1 ms render debounces coalesce; it never exceeds 1,001, one patch per item plus the parent); headroom only for the setTimeout count (81,000) and the heap (9.5 MB), as proposed in dev-plans/research/p45-perf-baseline.md §5.

heap.collectionCyclesMB.label: Heap MB after 5x1k Collection create/clear, minus ready (settled)
